title: Pet Companion Protocol
description: On-chain pet identity NFT with an event-only care log (vaccinations, checkups) and a linked ERC-20 reward minted automatically on each verified care event. metric: 17 passing tests, deployed & verified on Sepolia

title: Constrained Memory Update in 3D Reconstruction
description: Research on optimizing memory budgets in 3D reconstruction (Gaussian Splatting) formulated as a resource allocation problem. Implements a Q-learning network and CEM planners to optimize update decisions over heuristics.
metric: +17.1% Q-Learning and +22.2% CEM improvement over heuristics

title: Communication-Efficient Distributed Vector Memory
